title: Webhooks in 60 seconds
caption: Webhooks in 60 seconds: instead of asking an API if anything happened, let it tell you. #webhooks #api #webdev

scenes.title: Webhooks
scenes.say: Stop asking, is it done yet? every few seconds.
scenes.sub: Stop asking, is it done yet? every few seconds.

scenes.say: To know when a payment comes in, you could ask the API every few seconds. Almost every answer is no.

items.title: Register
items.say: You give the service a URL.

items.title: Event
items.say: Something happens: a payment, a push, a signup.

items.title: POST
items.say: They send an HTTP request to your URL, with the details.

scenes.say: Always check the signature they send, so nobody else can fake an event.
That's a webhook. Don't call us, we'll call you.
